SELECT rooms.*,
m.content AS last_message_content, m.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, m.created_at AS last_message_at,
u.name, u.profile_image_url,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m3 WHERE m3.room_id = rooms.room_id AND m3.sender_id != #{login_user_id} AND m3.is_read = 0 ) AS unread_count
FROM chat_rooms rooms
JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = rooms.project_id
LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.message_id = ( SELECT m2.message_id FROM messages m2 WHERE m2.room_id = rooms.room_id ORDER BY m2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 )
-- ⭐ 상대방 user join JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN rooms.freelancer_id = #{login_user_id} THEN p.client_id ELSE rooms.freelancer_id END
WHERE rooms.freelancer_id = #{login_user_id} OR p.client_id = #{login_user_id}
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT cr.room_id, cr.project_id, p.title, u.user_id, u.name, u.profile_image_url, m.message_id, m.content, m.sender_id, m.created_at, m.deleted_at, m.is_read, m.is_deleted, m.file_name, m.file_url, m.file_size FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN projects p ON cr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN p.client_id = #{login_user_id} THEN cr.freelancer_id ELSE p.client_id END LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.room_id = cr.room_id WHERE cr.room_id = #{room_id} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC

SELECT r.room_id, r.project_id, p.title, u.user_id, u.name, u.profile_image_url FROM chat_rooms r JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.project_id JOIN users u ON (CASE WHEN r.freelancer_id = #{login_user_id} THEN p.client_id ELSE r.freelancer_id END) = u.user_id WHERE r.room_id = #{room_id}
